sanskrit: yā āpo yāś ca devatā yā virāḍ brahmaṇā saha | śarīraṃ brahma prāviśac charīre 'dhi prajāpatiḥ ||
english: The waters, and the deities, and she who is Virāj together with Brahman — Brahman entered the body, and Prajāpati entered upon the body.

sanskrit: sūryaś cakṣur vātaḥ prāṇaṃ puruṣasya vi bhejire | athāsyetaram ātmānaṃ devāḥ prāyacchann agnaye ||
english: Sūrya apportioned the eye of the Puruṣa, Vāyu apportioned his breath; then the gods delivered his remaining self to Agni.

sanskrit: tasmād vai vidvān puruṣam idaṃ brahmeti manyate | sarvā hy asmin devatāḥ śarīre 'dhi samāhitāḥ ||
english: Therefore the knower holds this Puruṣa to be Brahman, for all the gods are gathered together upon the body within him.

sanskrit: yadaibhya sthānam aṅgeṣu pitā lokām̐ akalpayat | śarīraṃ sarvā devatā yathāṅgam anu prāviśan ||
english: When the Father apportioned the worlds as stations in the limbs for them, all the gods entered into the body limb by limb.

sanskrit: aṅgamaṅgaṃ śarīrasya sarve devā anu prāviśan | pitā hy ebhyaḥ prāyacchat taṃ lokam aparājitam ||
english: All the gods entered limb after limb of the body, for the Father granted them that unconquered world.

sanskrit: taṃ lokam aparājitaṃ sarve devā anu prāviśan | prajāpatir yam ābharac charīraṃ bahudhā hitam ||
english: All the gods entered that unconquered world, the body laid down in manifold ways, which Prajāpati had brought forth.

sanskrit: agne jāyasvāditir nāthiteyaṃ brahmaudanaṃ pacati putrakāmā | saptaṛṣayo bhūtakṛtas te tvā manthantu prajayā saheha ||
english: O Agni, be born — Aditi, who seeks a patron, cooks this brahma-rice-oblation, desiring sons. May the seven sages, the makers of beings, churn you here together with offspring.

sanskrit: kṛṇuta dhūmaṃ vṛṣaṇaḥ sakhāyo 'droghāvitā vācam accha | ayam agniḥ pṛtanāṣāṭ suvīro yena devā asahanta śatrūn ||
english: Make smoke, O vigorous friends, O guileless guardian, toward the sacred speech. This Agni, conqueror of armies, richly heroic, is he by whom the gods overpowered their enemies.

sanskrit: agne 'janiṣṭhā mahate vīryāya brahmaudanāya paktave jātavedaḥ | saptarṣayo bhūtakṛtas te tvājījanann asmai rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yaccha ||
english: O Agni, O Jātavedas, you were born for great heroic might, to cook the brahma-rice-oblation. The seven sages, the makers of beings, engendered you — bestow upon him riches replete with all heroes.

sanskrit: samiddho agne samidhā samidhyase viśvān devān yajñiyām̐ eha vakṣaḥ | tebhyo havyaṃ śrapayañ jātavedaḥ svargaṃ lokam adhi rohayainam ||
english: O Agni, kindled, you are kindled with fuel; you shall carry hither all the sacred gods. O Jātavedas, cooking the oblation for them, make him ascend to the heavenly world.

sanskrit: tredhā bhāgo nihito jātavedo yaḥ puro vo devānāṃ pitṝṇām uta martyānām | aṃśāṃ jānīdhvaṃ vi bhajāmi taṃ vo yo devānāṃ sā imaṃ pārayāti ||
english: O Jātavedas, the share which has been set threefold before you — for the gods, for the Pitṛs, and for mortals — know your portions; I distribute that to you: that which belongs to the gods shall convey him across.

sanskrit: agne sahasvān abhibhūr abhīd asi nīco nyubja dviṣataḥ sapatnān | iyaṃ mātrā mīyamānā mitā ca sajātāṃs te balihṛtaḥ kṛṇotu ||
english: O Agni, you are mighty, the one who overpowers, the prevailing one; press down the rivals and enemies face downward. This measured portion, measured out, shall make your kindred bring tribute to you.

sanskrit: sākaṃ sajātaiḥ payasā sahaidhy ud ubjainaṃ mahate vīryāya | ūrdhvo nākasyādhi roha viṣṭapaḥ svargo loka iti yaṃ vadanti ||
english: Thrive together with your kindred by means of milk; press him upward for great heroic might. Ascend erect upon the vault of the sky, upon the firmament — that which they call the heavenly world.

sanskrit: iyaṃ mahī prati gṛhṇātu carma pṛthivī devī sumanasyamānā | adhi gacchema sukṛtām ulokam ||
english: Let this great earth, the divine Pṛthivī, well-disposed in mind, receive the skin. May we attain the world of the well-doers on high.

sanskrit: etau grāvāṇau sayujā yuṅdhi carmaṇi nir bhindhy aṃśūn yajamānāya sādhu | avaghnatī ni jahi ye pṛtanyava ūrdhvāṃ prajām uddharanty ud ūha ||
english: Yoke these two pressing-stones joined together upon the skin; press out the soma-shoots well for the sacrificer. Smiting them down, strike down those who are hostile; lift up the offspring on high and raise it.

sanskrit: gṛhāṇa grāvāṇau sukṛtā vīra hasta ā te devā yajñiyā yajñam aguḥ | trayo varā yatamāṃs tvaṃ vṛṇīṣe tās te samṛddhīr iha rādhāyāmi ||
english: Take the pressing-stones, O hero of good deeds, with your hands; hither have the sacred gods come to your sacrifice. Three boons — whichever you choose — those prosperities I shall fulfil for you here.

sanskrit: upaśvase druvaye sīdatā yūyaṃ vi vicyadhvaṃ yajñiyāsas tuṣaiḥ | śriyā samānān ati sarvānt syāma- -adhaspadaṃ dviṣatas pādayema ||
english: Settle, you who are sacred, upon the press-board and the druvā ladle; scatter the husks away. May we surpass all those equal to us in prosperity, and may we bring our enemies underfoot.

sanskrit: iyaṃ te dhītir idam u te janitraṃ gṛhṇātu tvām aditiḥ śūraputrā | parā punīhi ya imāṃ pṛtanyavo asmai rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yaccha ||
english: This is your thought, this is your birthplace; may Aditi, mother of heroes, receive you. Purify and drive away those who are hostile to this one; bestow upon him riches replete with all heroes.

sanskrit: parehi nāri punar ehi kṣipram apāṃ tvā goṣṭho adhy arukṣad bharāya | tāsāṃ gṛhṇītād yatamā yajñiyā asan vibhājya dhīrītarā jihītāt ||
english: O woman, go apart; come back quickly — the cow-pen of the waters has mounted over you for the purpose of bearing. Among these waters, let whichever is most sacred take hold; having distributed, let the more resolute one leap forward.

sanskrit: emā agur yoṣitaḥ śumbhamānā ut tiṣṭha nāri tavasaṃ rabhasva | supatnī patyā prajāvatyā tvā- -agan yajñaḥ prati kumbhaṃ gṛbhāya ||
english: These women have come adorning themselves; arise, O woman, seize strength eagerly. The sacrifice has come to you as a good consort, fruitful with offspring for your husband — grasp the pot.

sanskrit: ūrjo bhāgo nihito yaḥ purā va ṛṣipraśiṣṭāpa ā haraitāḥ | ayaṃ yajño nāthavid gātuvit prajāvid ugraḥ paśumad vīravid vo astu ||
english: The share of strength that was deposited for you aforetime — bring hither these waters enjoined by the seers. May this sacrifice, knowing your need, knowing the path, knowing offspring, be fierce, rich in cattle, knowing heroes, for you.

sanskrit: agne carur yajñiyas tvādhy arukṣac chucis tapiṣṭhas tapasā tapainam | ārṣeyā daivā abhisaṃgatya bhāgam imaṃ tapiṣṭhā ṛtubhis tapantu ||
english: O Agni, the sacred oblation-pot has mounted over you, the pure and most ardent; with fervor, scorch it. Let the seer-born and god-born ones assemble together, and let the most ardent heat this portion with the ritual seasons.

sanskrit: śuddhā āpo yoṣito yajñiyā imā āpaś carum iva sarpantu śubhrāḥ | dadat prajā bahulān paśūn me paktaudanasya sukṛtām etu lokam ||
english: These pure, female, sacred waters — let these bright waters glide like an oblation-pot. Bestowing upon me offspring and many cattle, let him who cooked the rice-oblation go to the world of the well-doers.

sanskrit: brahmaṇā śuddhā uta pūtā ghṛtena somasyāṃśavas taṇḍulā yajñiyā ime | apaḥ pra viśatu prati gṛhṇātu vaś carur imaṃ paktvā sukṛtām etu lokam ||
english: These rice-grains, sacred, purified by brahman and cleansed with ghee, are the portions of Soma. Let it enter the waters; let the oblation-pot receive you; having cooked this, let him go to the world of the well-doers.

sanskrit: abhyāvartasva prajayā sahaināṃ pratyaṅ enaṃ devatābhiḥ sahaidhi | svargaṃ lokam abhi saṃ vahainam ādityo devaḥ paramaṃ vyoma ||
english: Turn back hither together with offspring; face him and unite him with the gods. Carry him jointly to the heavenly world — O divine Āditya, to the highest firmament.

sanskrit: uruḥ prathasva mahatā mahimnā sahasrapṛṣṭhaḥ sukṛtasya loke | pitāmahāḥ pitaraḥ prajopaja- -ahaṃ paktvā pañcadaśas te asmi ||
english: Spread wide with great greatness, O thousand-ridged one, in the world of the well-doer. O grandfathers, O fathers, O progenitor of offspring — having cooked, I am your fifteenth.
